admission: Every execution requires the complete expected profile. It includes an opaque per-process authority ID, algorithm contract, source SHA-256 digests, Node executable SHA-256, and Node/V8/platform/architecture/launch identity. A restart or mismatch requires explicit re-admission; clients never refresh profiles or fall back to native execution automatically.
integrity: inputHash binds the exact normalized request including the expected profile; resultHash binds every result field except resultHash using the exact structural encoding below. outputHash alone retains the selected legacy output's unchanged nine-decimal canonical SHA-256. Both clients verify all three hashes. Hashes are not signatures or remote attestation.
exactStructuralEncoding: SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON of recursively tagged values: null->["null"], bool->["bool",value], string->["string",value], number->["number",16 lowercase hex digits of big-endian IEEE-754 binary64], array->["array",projected elements], object->["object",[key,projected value] pairs sorted by UTF-8 key bytes]. Signed zero folds to positive zero for JSON transport; nonfinite numbers are rejected.
scope: Both clients delegate to the same admitted Node process. This is not independent Python/JavaScript numerical parity, proof across separately provisioned environments, or a portable math kernel. Runtime metadata does not describe the complete dynamic-library or CPU execution closure.
compatibility: Existing native APIs, engine/model versions, v1/v2 outputs and historical vectors are unchanged. Authority service and Node client require the source checkout and Node >=22.6 with type stripping. The stdlib Python client can be installed independently and connects to an explicitly supplied loopback endpoint.
